definitions.explanation: The sport of racing horses, typically with betting. In Japan, this is a popular form of legalized gambling.

examples.japanese: {競馬|けいば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}に→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to watch horse racing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{競馬|けいば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賭|か}けている→賭ける：09859_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: My father bets on horse racing every week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{競馬|けいば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦レース→レース：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}くの→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese horse racing is famous worldwide, and large races attract many spectators.

examples.japanese: {競馬|けいば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{馬券|ばけん}→馬券：22321_baken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{外|はず}れた→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧。
examples.english: I bought a horse racing ticket, but it didn't win.

examples.japanese: {競馬|けいば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: I checked the horse racing results on my smartphone.

notes:
{競馬|けいば} refers to the sport of horse racing. In Japan, it is one of the few forms of legal gambling alongside ⟦{競輪|けいりん}→競輪：09247_keirin⟧ (bicycle racing), ⟦{競艇|きょうてい}→競艇：noentry⟧ (boat racing), and ⟦オートレース→オートレース：noentry⟧ (motorcycle racing).

Common collocations:
- {競馬|けいば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to watch horse racing)
- {競馬|けいば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賭|か}ける→賭ける：09859_kakeru⟧ (to bet on horse racing)
- ⟦{競馬場|けいばじょう}→競馬場：noentry⟧ (racetrack)
- {競馬|けいば}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧ (horse racing fan)

Cultural note: Major races like the ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ダービー and the ⟦{有馬記念|ありまきねん}→有馬記念：noentry⟧ draw huge audiences and significant betting pools.
